scaleTier.description: Optional. Deprecated: Use scale_type instead. The effective scale tier of the storage pool. If `scale_tier` is not specified during creation, this defaults to `SCALE_TIER_STANDARD`.
enumDescriptions: Deprecated: Use ScaleType instead. The default value. This value is unused.
Deprecated: Use ScaleType instead. The standard capacity and performance tier. Suitable for general purpose workloads.
